title: Supply Chain Project Manager I
text:
What You Will Do
Plan and run supply chain improvement projects across planning, procurement and logistics; build project plans and report status to the operations leadership team.
Minimum Qualifications
1-2 years of experience in supply chain, logistics or project coordination.
Bachelor’s degree required in supply chain management, industrial engineering, business or a related field.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with SAP or Oracle ERP.
